about: The error types the detectors raise, in the order every list, scale and query shows them. Read by the backend (app/error_types.py) and the frontend (ui/src/store/errorColors.js). Adding a detector is adding an entry here and its detect_<key> method in app/db_utils/detector_sql.py - see DEVNOTES.md. label: the attribute list's name for it. short_label and noun: the compare panel's measure menu and axes. color and text_color: its swatches, bars and table cells, and the text on them. table_priority: which colours a table cell flagged several ways, lowest first. ai_definition and ai_tool_phrase: how the AI's system prompt and its tools explain it.

error_types.label: Missing Values
error_types.ai_definition: the cell is empty, NULL, or the literal text "null"/"undefined"/"nan"

error_types.label: Data Type Mismatch
error_types.ai_definition: the value is not of the column's dominant data type
error_types.ai_tool_phrase: the wrong data type for the column

error_types.label: Average Anomalies (Outliers)
error_types.ai_definition: the value is a statistical outlier for the column

error_types.label: Incomplete Data (< 3 points)
error_types.ai_definition: the value is partial or truncated
